query: Draft a GDPR privacy notice for our new scheduling feature. We collect calendar availability and attendee email addresses, but I do not know where the data is stored, how long we retain it, or which subprocessors receive it.
expected_behavior: Does not draft definitive retention, storage, or subprocessor claims from missing facts
Requests or builds the data map for purpose, storage, retention, recipients, and controller/processor roles before drafting the notice
Identifies lawful basis per processing purpose rather than assuming consent is the default
Marks the missing facts and recommends counsel review for unresolved high-risk transfer or role questions
